sub_answers.text: In 2014 the club changed its legal form from an incorporated body to a company limited which took 100% ownership of the Hobart City Football Club, with Hobart City Demons becoming the trading name of North Hobart Football Club Ltd [d8767658s0p0]. Paying members voted 371–118 on 9 October 2017 to return the playing name of the club to the North Hobart identity for the 2018 season and beyond, which was the outcome of that governance decision [d8767658s0p0].

sub_answers.text: The club was a part of the Tasmanian Football League from the early 1900s until 2001 [d8767658s0p0]. The club joined the Southern Football League in 2001 and competed there after leaving the TFL [d8767658s0p0]. In 2009 North Hobart was invited into the second reincarnation of the statewide Tasmanian league and remained there until 2013 [d8767658s0p0]. North Hobart returned to the Tasmanian State League in 2018 and after the TSL ceased in 2024 the club rejoined the Southern Football League in 2025 [d8767658s0p0].
